description: This Java source file defines the AcknowledgementFactory class, which provides static methods for creating and combining acknowledgement objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating individual acknowledgements, collections of acknowledgements, and empty acknowledgements, primarily used for end-to-end acknowledgement handling.

classes.name: AcknowledgementFactory
classes.description: A final class providing static factory methods for creating acknowledgement objects and collections within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: newAcknowledgement
methods.description: Creates a new Acknowledgement instance with specified label, entity ID, status code, headers, and optional payload.

methods.name: newAcknowledgements
methods.description: Creates a collection of acknowledgements from a collection of individual acknowledgements and headers.

methods.name: newAcknowledgements
methods.description: Creates a combined acknowledgements object based on entity ID, acknowledgements collection, status code, and headers, typically used for deserialization.

methods.name: emptyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Creates an empty acknowledgements collection for a given entity ID and headers.
